First, we differentiate $x(y)$ with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}y} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}y}(5{y}^{3}-10{y}^{2}) \\  & =5\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}y}({y}^{3})-10\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}y}({y}^{2}) \\  & =15{y}^{2}-20y\end{aligned}
$$

Now, taking the reciprocal of $\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}y},$ we get

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}={(\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}y})}^{-1}=\frac{1}{15{y}^{2}-20y}.
$$
